detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation via Hybrid Architectures and Goal Generation
detail.summary: Autonomous discovery systems face critical challenges in iterative experiment refinement. Success in independent problem identification and sustained investigation requires robust self-healing mechanisms and meta-strategy exploration, which allow agents to recover from localized failure modes in complex, non-stationary scientific environments.
detail.reason: Incorporating evidence on failure modes in automated discovery and the comparative advantage of meta-strategies.

detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Investigation
detail.question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?
detail.reason: Continuing active work under the unassigned problem topic with freshly collected source evidence.
